title: Jaa Raha Hai Qafla
body:
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Koi to aa kar sambhale abide bimar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Paon me bedi hai gardan me hai taoqe khardar
Ro raha hai khun ke ansu har qadam zaro qatar
Maot aa jae kahin na qafla salar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Har qadam barsa rahe hain pusht par durre lain
Kya kisi laghar pe aysa zulm hota hai kahin
Ye sitam karne se koi rokle aghiyar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Sakht kitna imtehane abide bimar hai
Able pairo me hai aor ablo me khar hai
Kis trha se tai karega wo rahe purkhar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Sar brahena ja rahin hain fatema ki betiyan
Balo se chehra chupae bazuwo me rassiyan
Koi to chadar udha de zainabe lachar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Jis trha girya kuna ayi thi binte mustafa saww
Aj Zainab sa ko wanhi hai be rida laya gaya
Zalimo ne phir sajaya hai usi darbar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Is tarha ale nabi ko tumne yun ruswa kiya
Aye musalmano yahi kya hai risalat ka sila
Hashr me tum kya kahoge ahemad e mokhtar saww ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
Ho bhala kaise raqam aye “manzar” e khasta jigar
Kya mazalim ho gaye hai Abid e
Bimar par
Jisne budha kar diya hai ek ghairatdar ko…
Ja raha hai qafla sham ke bazar ko ×2
